Therefore, the printed report incorporates the basic information and does not attempt to format the report. But the report can be printed on any AirPrint-compatible printer.

My OBs is designed for obstetric doctors to manage patients. It is simple to use and input patient data. and it will clearly show the distribution of patient's EDC  and delivery date on calendar. It's convient for professionals to arrange schedules.

Features:
- iCloud enabled.
- Calendar View reports
- EDC and delivery dates statistics.
- Copyable Table Content
- Post-term alerts
- Multiple languages compatible (English, Français, Español, 繁體中文, 简体中文)
- GA calculator
- Scheduled C/S time note
- back up to dropbox 
- restore from dropbox
- Schedule calendar and event statistics
